pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients; regions are relatively large on the neck and transition to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, thin light-toned pathways forming a consistent negative-space graph with predominantly tri-radiate junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the cervical dorsal line against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A significant localized area of de-pigmentation and patch blurring is visible on the upper shoulder and mid-dorsal flank, where patch edges become indistinct.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, irregular skin flap or lesion is visible on the ventral-lateral aspect of the lower neck/chest area.
